name: Sit-Down Breakfast Hot Oatmeal, Cream of Wheat & White Hominy Grits
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Silky Cream of Wheat (farina), plain white hominy grits, and slow-simmered oatmeal are top-tier soluble-fiber flare foods.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with brown sugar, honey, or maple syrup on the side and ask your server to hold the toasted pecan garnish.
watchOuts: Hold toasted pecans that sometimes accompany hot oatmeal
Request almond/oat milk instead of dairy milk
